SELECT campaign_id,
       COUNT(*) AS sent,
       COUNTIF(opened_at IS NOT NULL) AS opened,
       COUNTIF(clicked_at IS NOT NULL) AS clicked
FROM `{table}`
WHERE channel = 'sms'
  AND sent_at >= DATETIME '2025-10-01'
  AND sent_at <  DATETIME '2025-11-01'
GROUP BY campaign_id
ORDER BY campaign_id
